summary: RoyaLand Co Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting entry into a Sale and Purchase Agreement dated May 27, 2026, to acquire 90% of Savoia 1908 Football Club S.r.l., an Italian Serie D football club. Consideration comprised 5 million Class B Shares (par value $0.0002) to seller CRH Royalty (24% CEO-owned) and 2 million Class B Shares to the club. CRH retains 10%. A shareholder agreement and lockup on the 5 million shares were signed. No cash price, premium, or board recommendation stated. The acquisition of a sports club non-core to software services suggests strategic diversification. Watch for completion details and shareholder dilution impact, as deal closing timeline is unspecified.
